AUDIT-7 Lane 4 batch 3 progress — 126 valid PRs audited, 4 invalid payload references (2026-11-25)

This slice processed #7865, #7866, #7867, #7868 and #7872:

- #7865 → #6164: `audit:complete` (board identity, payload hash/size, and view-receipt contracts).
- #7866 → #3869: `audit:partial` (empty-day watchdog added; the written container-target acceptance is not fully evidenced). Lane 2 closure pointer: #13871 comment 7158982068.
- #7867 → #7084: `audit:complete` (GitHub hot-list events in the common activity stream with durable checkpoints and explicit coverage limits).
- #7868 → #3975: `audit:complete` (cycle groups, external-ref diagnostics and audited graph actions).
- #7872 → #5824: `audit:complete` (Redis hot store / regular-store system-of-record design).

The PR bodies, diffs, comments, source issue/comment captures, verdicts and label readbacks are in [the continuation ledger](https://github.com/developing-today/code/blob/audit7-batch3-five-20261125/doc/20261125_merged-pr-audit_audit7-batch3-prs-7865-7872/20261125_merged-pr-audit_audit7-batch3-prs-7865-7872.md), on the existing docs PR #14847.

Cumulative count: 126 valid PRs audited from 130 payload entries; four payload identifiers (#7667, #7668, #7693, #7694) are issues rather than PRs; 120 identifiers remain, next #7874. Earlier count corrections are recorded in comments 7156848591 and 7156775726.
